song.name: The Tilt
song.plot: Before Nyktoros wakes: Vorgos, Sentinel of the Aether, senses the planar balance tilting. Two soul-leaks drain the light — Acheron's vampiric soul-banking in Eldoria and Malakar's ritual sacrifices in Nythoria — and the Underworld's soul-pool nears critical mass. The sleeping Void stirs beneath. Grave opener of the trilogy.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Vorgos the Stormbringer, first person. Universal Sentinel, Aether-dweller, pragmatic — not omniscient, not benevolent. Verse 1 establishes the three planes as frequencies on the scales. Verse 2 names the two leaks (Acheron's banked vampire souls in Eldoria; Malakar's blood rites in Nythoria) that feed the Underworld's soul-pool. Bridge is Vorgos's own weight — he is the balance-keeper, and something is owed — without naming the scholar, the Rift, or any war. Anchors: the Aether, Auroria/Eldoria/Nythoria, the tilt of the scales, the sleeping Void beneath the Underworld, the Stormbringer's domain. No Nyktoros-awake, no Rift, no Anya, no Seraphina/Valen, no battle imagery. Uniform 9-10 syllable meter per section. Suggested Suno direction: low, slow, brooding — deep strings, storm-rumble, restrained drums, ominous choir swells. Grave opener.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: The Aether trembles at the turning scale, Three planes aligned upon a fragile thread. In Auroria the quiet stars grow pale, And Eldoria has fed the silent dead.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.reworked: The Underworld is drinking, dark and deep, A pool of banked and restless souls asleep.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The tilt is slow, the scale is turning, Light is fading, night is learning. Something sleeping stirs below, And I must weigh what all the worlds will owe.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: The Thirst-bank vaults in Eldoria swell, The crimson rites on Nythoria's blood-soaked stone. Two leaks that feed a reservoir of hell, And the balance bends beneath their gathering tone.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The tilt is slow, the scale is turning, Light is fading, night is learning. Something sleeping stirs below, And I must weigh what all the worlds will owe.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: I am the Stormbringer, the keeper of the weight, I do not bend, I only watch and weigh. The storm has gathered in my silent chest, And what the balance asks, I must not rest.
